svg.text: Made up for this project. It is not the real floor plan of Redmond High School.
room in the lab: a 2960 switch, 15 student PCs (VLAN 10), 1 teacher PC (VLAN 20)
MDF: both edge routers, both core and both distribution switches, SW-MDF, 4 servers, 2 IT PCs
not in the lab, only drawn so it looks like a school
two uplinks per room switch, one to each
